about.title: About this piece
body: Camera Ready is a satirical artwork and research demo. It moves the engagement design of commercial sports betting apps onto academic publishing, so you can feel the incentive structure many researchers already work inside.
No real money is involved. Points have no value and cannot be bought, sold, won, or redeemed.
Play is anonymous. You are identified only by three initials and a slip code that only you hold.
